guide.autoturgy.0:
AUTOTURGY · FIELD NOTES
Signals, measured storage, real mirror transport, thirsty fluids and paid essentia machinery for Thaumaturge 1.0.4. Host research and magical crafting now govern magical devices. Actual golem delivery, later constructs, XP and equipment remain pending. Search these original notes by any word.
guide.autoturgy.1:
DIRECTION & CONTROL
Place a device with its marked face toward you. The marked front emits power; the rear receives it. Right-click empty-handed for controls. A clock can also be started by sneak-clicking it. A comparator reads progress or measured strength. Never point an output back into its own input.
guide.autoturgy.2:
ORDINARY HOURGLASS
Choose 5–60 seconds in five-second steps. Sneak-click, use Start, or apply a rising signal at the rear. The clock runs once and ends with a two-tick pulse. The comparator rises from 0 to 15 as time passes. Elapsed time is saved; unloading pauses time.
guide.autoturgy.3:
MAGIC HOURGLASS
Set precise whole seconds up to one hour. Outputs: completion pulse, power while running, a latch alternating at each completion, power while running with a repeat gap, or disabled. Repeat starts another period. Restart permits a new trigger to reset elapsed time. Cancel-on-falling clears the current period. Powered/unpowered trigger modes pause time when their condition is absent; Ignore waits for manual activation and ignores redstone.
guide.autoturgy.4:
REDCRYSTAL ROUTING
Crystals attach to the face you place them against. Adjacent crystals on that same surface share signals. Enabled corner routing wraps a shared support block. Each world-direction face can be Off, Input, Output, or Both. Normal propagation loses one strength per surface step. Internal power can exceed 15; emitted vanilla power is capped at 15. A graph above 512 crystals refuses power.
guide.autoturgy.5:
SPECIAL REDCRYSTALS
Amplified crystals raise positive input to 31. Dim crystals cap signals; Dense crystals reject weak input. Resonating pairs carry signals straight up to 15 blocks without distance loss. Mercurial crystals attach beside paired host mirrors: copy each adjacent mirror into its crystal with an eye. The mirror-facing connection carries internal power to the crystal beside the other end. Both ends must already be loaded and paired. Removing sources turns even zero-loss cycles off.
guide.autoturgy.6:
EYES & REMOTE READINGS
Sneak-use a crystalline eye on the target face; its tooltip records dimension, position and face. Use it on a reader to copy the link without consuming the eye. Targets must be loaded, in the same dimension and within 20 blocks. The remote comparator reads a target with a comparator output. Invalid targets produce zero; readers never load chunks.
guide.autoturgy.7:
VIS READER
Reads host jars through their selected-sided capability, crucibles, nodes, infusion demand wand-bearing arcane workbenches and recharge pedestals. Choose Total, Highest, Lowest or Aspect Count; invert if needed. Choose an aspect by name; that stable ID remains selected when contents change. Capacity 0 uses jar/crucible/node or actual wand capacity; unknown storage and infusion demand need manual capacity. Wand amounts use centivis. Aspect Count emits the number of types directly and ignores selection/capacity. Node highest/lowest compares current/base fullness, including depleted aspects. Reader access never consumes essentia.
guide.autoturgy.8:
RUNIC FILTERS
Open a filter and click a carried stack into a ghost square; your real stack stays on the cursor. Left-click with an empty cursor clears a sample. Right-click an existing sample with an empty cursor increases its quantity; Shift-click an inventory stack adds a sample. Blacklist toggles conversion without clearing data. Components, damage, shared item tags and matching mod can be selected independently. Sneak-use while another filter is in your off hand to copy all settings. Apply a filter to a tally by right-clicking it.
guide.autoturgy.9:
TALLY & ENTITY SENSING
The tally counts matching items accessible for extraction from the selected face. Minimum and Full-strength counts map the total to power. Chains have a 16-hop cycle guard. Unbound lenses count loose items near the target; Yield lenses predict normal and silk-touch alternatives with a suitable tool and isolated deterministic RNG, without breaking the block. Dynamic/random loot is sampled in those two contexts rather than exhaustively enumerated. An Entity Eye binds a creature type or a specific player; sneak-use it to bind yourself. Signum Entia counts all entities, including vehicles, in an 11-wide box shaped by its six adjacent faces. One blocked side extends the opposite reach to ten; two blocked ends suppress that axis. Glass and replaceable neighbors are ignored, and distant walls do not change the box. The modern half-span control can reduce the default five. Age selection applies to living entities only. Player identity can be required or ignored to detect all players. Raw counts up to 255 remain available to redcrystal.
guide.autoturgy.10:
RECIPES & PROGRESSION
Open the Autoturgy category in the host research book after unlocking Artifice. Complete its normal knowledge and obtain stages. Magical devices use host arcane or infusion recipes with real research, crystals, wand vis and/or essentia. The ordinary inverter, ordinary hourglass, field guide, soup and milk conversion are intentional mundane crafts. Recipe amounts and costs are modern defaults, not claims of unknown historical numbers. Actual golem delivery and later feature families remain pending.
menu.autoturgy.request_modifiers: Shift changes a stack; Ctrl multiplies by ten. Alt permits requests above stock. Worker delivery is pending.
message.autoturgy.tome_unavailable: Needs a loaded linked core, adjacent memory and nearby Ordo relay.
tooltip.autoturgy.hand_mirror: Sneak-use a paired mirror to link. Use with an opposite-hand list to copy it; sneak-use copies the second list. Automatic mode sends explicitly listed items only.
guide.autoturgy.11:
PHYSICAL STORAGE
Place Hungry or Finical Maws against any inventory face. They absorb nearby loose items into that face and leave overflow in the world. Finical applies an attached runic filter. Chests hold 27 stacks. Tenacious reserves one of each item type against automation across all slots; its normal player slots allow manual removal. Breaking chests drops their contents once. A remote comparator can read their real fullness.
guide.autoturgy.12:
GREEDY & EAGER CHESTS
Greedy watches enabled acquisition directions every ten ticks, taking only positive new deposits after its initial baseline. Share accumulates fractional percentages fairly even for single-item deposits; Own stock fills a target; Neighbor reserve takes new excess. Apply a filter and use a stick for controls. Hoppers below and reciprocal greedy acquisition are refused, while ordinary bottom inventories and one-way greedy sharing work. Eager trades only with its owner and authorized users. Whitelist quantities restock the player, deposit excess and return nonlisted chest items. Blacklist mode deposits nonlisted items and returns listed chest surplus above the configured chest reserve. Sneaking bypasses trade. The owner applies a player-bound entity eye to authorize, or sneak-applies it to revoke. Contents remain normal manual storage.
guide.autoturgy.13:
INVENTARIUM STRUCTURE
Build amber block or amber bricks, a host Ordo crystal directly above, then the core directly above that. Eight eligible bookshelves anywhere in the radius-three cube complete this modern arrangement. All shelves in that cube add capacity: ordinary 81, Enchanting 216, Ensorcelled 486, with a modern safety cap of 16384 slots. The special shelves provide 4 and 8 ordinary shelves of enchanting power. One baseline scribe plus one per nearby Ordo crystal is allowed; each crystal also adds 8 to the base link distance of 10. The core never owns or creates indexed items. Its menu toggles tally between stock and demand; a tally can also read a core shelf or a remote comparator linked to the core.
guide.autoturgy.14:
SCRIBES & OCULUS
Bind an eye to the core and attach it to a Scribe in range. The first inventory found directly behind its marked face selects the default container type. The default scan is a 7-cube and costs one real centivis Ordo per scan, normally once a second, through a host relay. A stick opens access-face controls; sneak-click forgets the default type. Empty-hand right-click shows local or whole-system contents. Put an Oculus above it and copy up to five eyes: every eye aimed at that scribe adds one to scan radius; other eyes add the loaded container type they observe. These may be mixed. Empty-hand click removes the last eye. Scribes deduplicate storage including double chests, require whole-container capacity, honor selected sides and never load chunks.
guide.autoturgy.15:
REQUESTS & MEMORY
Place one Memory for each placed Tome or Dispersing Mirror. Eligible Memory lies in the 7×2×7 area two and three below the core and touches amber; every physical Memory grants exactly one persistent device slot. Place a Tome, then copy a core-bound eye into it. Range follows the same 10+8-per-crystal rule, and it needs a steady Ordo relay supply at one centivis per second. Search or sort the complete live catalogue and use arrows or the wheel to page. Stock, reserved and wanted are separate. Plus/minus changes your own orders; Shift changes stacks, Ctrl multiplies by ten, Alt allows more than stock. Click a cursor item into the ghost square, or Shift-click inventory, to request an out-of-stock identity without consuming it. Zero cancels. Worker custody metadata survives reduction, cancellation and reload. Actual golem collection/delivery remains PENDING.
guide.autoturgy.16:
MIRROR TRANSPORT
Melding copies an eye aimed at the entrance of a real paired host mirror route. Hand, hopper and loose-item input emerge from the paired exit; cross-dimension endpoints must already be loaded. A placed Tome has a real input slot. Its Mirrors button chooses input or output configuration; close the menu, then apply an eye aimed at a mirror within 16 blocks. Input uses that mirror route; output names the actual local output mirror or Melding adapter. Dispersing binds a core eye and consumes dedicated Memory. It routes explicitly earmarked real worker custody to multiple tomes; ordinary matching input is always refused. Hungry Hand sneak-binds a paired mirror. Use an opposite-hand filter to copy list one, or sneak-use for list two. Automatic mode, toggled by sneak-use air, transfers only explicitly listed types. Whitelists send listed items; blacklist quantities retain a reserve and send surplus. Empty lists do nothing. Ordinary use can send an opposite-hand real stack manually. Invalid/full routes preserve all remainders. No addon route loads chunks.

guide.autoturgy.17:
THIRSTY TANK
A tank holds 16 buckets and exposes a real fluid capability on every face. Buckets and pipes work; water bottles and stew bowls each carry 250 mB. Every second it follows one connected fluid path up to 16 blocks and 256 visited positions, collecting one bucketable source only after checking space. Adjacent water sources remain renewable. Exposed rain adds 25 mB per collection. Breaking the tank drops one tank preserving its fluid and glyphs; placed tanks restore that data.
guide.autoturgy.18:
FACE GLYPHS
Apply a physical glyph to an empty face. Sneak-use that face with a stick or host wand to remove it. The control screen displays all six slates. Void accepts compatible overflow and destroys the excess. Each Consumption drains 100 mB per collection while respecting Preservation. Siphoning pushes up to one bucket out that face; Envy pulls one bucket from it. Temperance requires redstone for all intake. Preservation retains the last 1 mB. Each Guzzler speeds the collection period from 20 ticks, capped at 2. Each Reservoir adds 16 buckets; removal refuses when current contents exceed the smaller capacity. Each Bovine looks four blocks along its face for adult cows and disables world absorption. A persisted per-cow 1200-tick cooldown is shared by every tank.
guide.autoturgy.19:
MILK & SOUP
Milk uses NeoForge’s standard fluid identity. Craft a milk bucket into a Pouring Milk Bucket; ordinary use drinks and removes effects, sneak-use places a stable milk source. It can be bucketed back into ordinary milk and piped normally. This modern source does not spread. Mushroom and vishroom soup have flowing source blocks and placeable buckets. Four bowls fill a bucket; bowls return when eaten or poured. Vishroom stew uses actual host vishroom, gives little food, nausea, hunger and one temporary warp. Vishroom source immersion gives nausea and one temporary warp at most once every 200 ticks. Source random ticks can grow real vishrooms within two blocks where they survive. No exact legacy rate is claimed.
guide.autoturgy.20:
ALCHEMICAL BOILER
Insert fluid by bucket or pipe and real fuel by hand or item automation. Stack up to five actual host alembics directly above it. A complete 1000 mB batch takes 100 fuel ticks; up to four correctly aimed host bellows accelerate progress. Alumentum uses its actual host burn duration. Every resulting aspect must fit the alembics before work begins. Full output stalls without consuming fluid. The paid pending aspects persist if an output changes. Water, lava, milk and other indexed bucket fluids yield their actual bucket aspects minus the empty bucket’s aspects. Soup uses four net bowl servings. Unknown or empty net yields produce nothing. Breaking a boiler destroys contained fluid and paid pending aspects, and drops unused fuel.
guide.autoturgy.21:
ESSENTIA LOCUS CONSTRUCT
Modern explicit shape: lapis in the center of a 3×3 pool of eight water sources, enclosed by a complete 5×5 outer ring of silverwood planks at the same height. Put an Aqua crystal cluster over lapis and the locus over that. Apply a bound eye to a loaded real jar or reservoir; it is physically inserted. Empty-hand click removes the last eye; sneak-empty-hand opens status. Connected containers flood outward from each eye, deduplicated, initially 12 jars and one eye within 16 blocks. Up to eight extra Aqua clusters touching the wood ring add eight jars, one eye and eight range each. Removing required structure disables reading and extraction immediately. Remote readers target the locus; a Vis Reader beneath any water square also reads the combined amounts and labeled capacities.
guide.autoturgy.22:
ESSENTIA AGGREGATOR
Craft the aggregator with an actual Aqua cluster and place it directly below an existing locus, replacing the center cluster. Its visible embedded crystal preserves that resource; lapis, water and silverwood remain mandatory. The locus keeps its inserted eyes. The aggregator exposes the monitored original jars through actual host storage, conduit, legacy transport and infusion-source capabilities. Tubes, infusion and essentia mirrors extract from those jars once, respecting output sides and labels. No essentia is stored in the aggregator or reconstructed from readings. Removing an eye, jar or construct block changes the available source immediately. Relabeling a jar changes its per-aspect capacity, including empty labeled jars.

guide.autoturgy.23.title: Golems: links and inhibition
guide.autoturgy.23.body: Place an Inhibitor, Taskmaster or Workbench. Use a Golem Linking Bell on the device, then on your own Thaumaturge golem. Only its owner may control it. One golem has one device; each device has at most six golems. Sneak-use the bell on a device to clear every link; sneak-use another block to clear attunement. Links persist without loading remote chunks. An inhibitor needs active host fetters directly below it: one to four consecutive fetters give modern radii of 8, 16, 24 and 32 blocks. Its control menu selects exemption (0) or only linked targets (1). It affects only its owner's golems and yields to combat. Overlapping devices share the pause naturally; removing, disabling or unloading the last effect restores ordinary host goals. External NoAI and physical fetters are never overwritten. Linking and work require the same dimension. Changing dimension clears the device link; carried orders recover their physical items locally.
guide.autoturgy.24.title: Taskmasters: physical deliveries
guide.autoturgy.24.body: Bind a crystalline eye to a functional Inventarium Core, then attach it to a Taskmaster. Allocate a separate valid memory block for each Taskmaster and each placed Tome. The core's cluster-expanded link range applies. Link up to six host fill-compatible golems whose home centers lie within five blocks. Installed host 1.0.4 fill forbids Clumsy; advanced builds also carry Smart. Hands, legs and home must permit the journey. A paid, operational Tome chooses a nearby output through an eye and submits orders. Workers walk to indexed sided sources, extract real items, carry them in host hands and walk to the current allowed destination. A full or unloaded destination leaves custody in those hands. Cancellation returns surplus to the source or drops it safely when that source cannot accept it. Combat, owner-following and external pauses suspend work. No stock count becomes an item. Dispersing mirrors accept only explicit worker leases. Clear links to recover a stuck worker before reassigning it. Workers interact within two blocks of the physical block surface. Reloaded carried journeys continue walking while retaining the original home and range.
guide.autoturgy.25.title: Golem crafting
guide.autoturgy.25.body: Link an owned host Empty-compatible golem with its home within five blocks. Installed host Empty forbids Clumsy; a Smart head enables advanced patterns. In the Workbench menu, copy items from your cursor into nine blue ghost slots; place real ingredients in the middle storage. Ordinary registered crafting recipes are evaluated on the server. Basic golems handle patterns fitting 2 by 2 or using one ingredient type throughout; Smart golems use the whole grid. Product filters may be attached with a runic filter. Products accumulate on the right and route through the marked front into a sided inventory. Bottom automation extracts products; other faces access real ingredients. A fetter immediately below pauses crafting while output continues. Ingredient remainders return to storage; unrelated containers drop unless Order retains them. A nearby real Fabrico jar within two horizontal blocks and one vertical block supplies one essentia for forty endurance points when fatigue reaches twenty. Long work becomes slower after stored Fabrico is exhausted; resting restores endurance. All ingredients and buckets remain physical.
guide.autoturgy.26.title: Four workbench sides
guide.autoturgy.26.body: Use an upgrade on an empty cardinal side. Sneak-use that side with an empty hand or host wand to recover it. Four sides allow four upgrades. Air uses actual host movement speed to reduce the work interval and increases fatigue. Earth uses the greater of actual host material strength and attack damage for a smaller speed improvement and lowers fatigue. Each Fire adds one pattern page; at most two give three pages. Removing Fire retains dormant ghost patterns and all real contents. Order stores noningredient remainders where space permits. Entropy is unique: the real first ingredient slot identifies a placeholder; other stored items may replace all matching ghost cells only when an actual registered recipe produces the nominal product or a product explicitly allowed by your attached filter. Invalid combinations never consume ingredients. Modern Water adaptation: adjacent real water increases resting recovery by three points per Water side every second. Base work interval is forty ticks, at least four after upgrades; normal recovery is one endurance point per second. These are documented modern tuning defaults.
